table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	item.customicode,
	purorderdetail.alternatecustomicode,
	item.name, 
	manufname=manufacturer.name,
	currlistrow = 0,
	purorderdetail.pocode,
	purorderdetail.icode,   
	reorderqty = 0,
	stock = 0.0000,
	packingdesc=item.packingdesc,
	optimumqty = 0,
	foreignprice = purorderdetail.foreignprice,
	currencycode = (select h.currencycode from purorderheader h where h.pocode = purorderdetail.pocode),
	conversionfactor = (select h.conversionfactor from purorderheader h where h.pocode = purorderdetail.pocode),
	/*rate = item.purprice,*/
	PurPrice=purorderdetail.PurPrice,
	rate=purorderdetail.rate,
	discperc = purorderdetail.discperc,
	discperc2 =purorderdetail.discperc2,
	purorderdetail.bonusqty,
	looseqty = 0.0000,
	packunits = purorderdetail.packunits,
	purorderdetail.PORowID,
	purorderdetail.qty,
	avgprice = item.avgprice,
	gstperc = item.gstperc1,
	gcode = item.gcode,
	invleveldiscperc=(select discperc from purorderheader where purorderheader.pocode=purorderdetail.pocode),
	reqqty = Case When (purorderdetail.qtysatisfied >= purorderdetail.qty) THEN 0 Else (purorderdetail.qty - purorderdetail.qtysatisfied) END,
	reqbonusqty = Case When (purorderdetail.bonusqtysatisfied >= purorderdetail.bonusqty) THEN 0 Else (purorderdetail.bonusqty - purorderdetail.bonusqtysatisfied) END,
	qtysatisfied=purorderdetail.qtysatisfied,
	bonusqtysatisfied=purorderdetail.bonusqtysatisfied,
	packsalestax = item.packsalestax,
	recentpurprice = item.recentpurprice,
	invgstperc1=(select invgstperc1 from purorderheader where purorderheader.pocode=purorderdetail.pocode),
	saleprice = item.saleprice
FROM 
	purorderdetail,   
	item,
	manufacturer
WHERE 
	( dbo.purorderdetail.pocode = :ra_POCode )   and
	( purorderdetail.icode = item.icode ) and  
	( item.manfcode = manufacturer.manfcode ) and
	( purorderdetail.qty > purorderdetail.qtysatisfied or purorderdetail.bonusqty > purorderdetail.bonusqtysatisfied )
ORDER BY 
	purorderdetail.PORowID
